task:
The code is on branch feat/streamline-doctor-memory (309ba6c): `kit/hooks/kit_activity.py`, its rows in `kit/hook.py` TABLE, the page's `kit-now` line.

1. Find how an agy part's hook payload names its tool and input (run_command, edit_file, write_file) and its post.
2. Adapt `kit_activity.py` to them, with the same limits: no model call, at most one write every 15 s, nothing said but the loop line.
3. Wire it in the agy rows of the TABLE and test it the way tests/test_post_gate.py tests the Claude Code one.
4. Run one real agy part and record what the board showed, every few seconds.
